scope: route-card visual module; harbor fishing first

viewport.mobile: scale uniformly within viewport; preserve upright card and scroll page if needed

locationEmblem.rule: complete anchor circle fully visible above label; the medallion and its rim may not tuck beneath the plaque

locationLabel.rule: independent plaque, centered text by actual glyph bounds, with visible separation from emblem

cardFrame.rule: equal geometry for every route; theme colors and ornament assets replaceable

titlePlaque.rule: warm-white bold display text optically centered vertically within plaque by rendered glyph bounds; dark route-specific shadow

heroViewport.rule: separate replaceable image; cropped behind frame; focal subject and educational object in safe area

missionPlaque.rule: centered RTL native text; retain full copy without shrinking

difficultyMedallion.rule: separate icon asset; full annular rim/backing in route-family green for core, without orange/copper

pageReturn.rule: single centered text-only control outside card, returns to journey map; no arrow

title.size: > previous 82 design px; fit by shared plaque height, never perspective-shrink
title.shadow: dark blue-green on fishing; palette-specific dark shadow on other cards

otherText.shadow: subtle hue-related dark shadow; legibility checked at mobile width

palette.page: quiet warm ivory, fixed across cards
palette.dominance: each route's own color family must dominate hero illustration AND frame; warm secondary colors only as restrained material accents
palette.fishing: leaf/olive green and green-teal dominate; blue sea/sky permitted; wood/rope muted cream/gray-tan; orange roofs, orange dock and broad copper bands must not dominate
palette.monster: warm red/burgundy charcoal; warm red water, red eyes; no prominent blue/orange

states.front: full saturation for owned palette; upright
states.rear: same full card geometry, only title strips exposed; own hue with subtle saturation reduction, independent elevated edge and shadow, readable and selectable

replaceability.layout: slot coordinates and z-order in this file
replaceability.behavior: selection/confirmation and page navigation separate from appearance

qa: measure rendered glyph bounds and center within each plaque; do not assume baseline is optical center
overlay slot outlines during review and verify no emblem-label or mission-medallion collisions
inspect 320px and 390px wide portrait render; no title shrinking or clipped letters
measure color dominance across illustration and frame; inspect for broad competing orange/copper patches
compare rear title strips' saturation and tap targets
confirm Persian glyph joining and exact «اسکلهٔ ماهیگیری»
one page-level return goes to journey map
check complete emblem rim above label, difficulty-ring color, and text-only map return
limitation: Geometry is a first review prototype, not approved production measurements; existing game renderer remains unchanged.
